about.philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
about.philosophy.body: Knowledge is a shared commons and a fundamental right, not a commodity to be hoarded or paywalled. We exist to make high-quality, autodidactic learning a reality for everyone.
about.why.title: Why Dawnbook Exists
about.why.body: Dawnbook was built to actively reduce the education gap and reject exploitative paywalled models. By dismantling financial barriers, we ensure that free and open access is the baseline, not a premium feature.
about.core.title: Core Principles
about.core.1: Absolutely free with no hidden cost.
about.core.2: Driven by open collaboration and contribution from a worldwide community.
about.core.4: Fostering lifelong learning and the critical thinking necessary to pursue truth independently.
about.motif.title: The Dawn Motif
about.motif.body: The dawn signifies the end of the night and the arrival of a new era of freedom. It represents our profound belief that the light of education should reach every corner of the world, illuminating minds and liberating individuals.
contribute.join.title: Join the Authors
contribute.join.body1: We believe knowledge should be free and openly collaborative. You can contribute by writing a new chapter, fixing typos, or even starting a brand new book.
contribute.join.body2: All contributions are managed via GitHub Pull Requests, ensuring a high standard of quality through peer review.

dmca.title: DMCA Notice & Copyright Policy
dmca.intro: Dawnbook respects the intellectual property rights of others and expects its users and contributors to do the same. This policy outlines our compliance with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (17 U.S.C. § 512) and our notice-and-takedown procedures.
dmca.fairuse.title: 1. Educational Mission & Fair Use
dmca.fairuse.body: Dawnbook is a non-profit, open-access educational platform. Content published on this platform may include brief quotations, scholarly citations, diagrams, and formulas utilized strictly for educational analysis, commentary, criticism, and scholarship under the Fair Use doctrine (17 U.S.C. § 107) and applicable copyright exceptions.
dmca.notice.title: 2. Submitting a DMCA Takedown Notice
dmca.notice.body: If you are a copyright owner or an authorized agent thereof and believe that any content hosted on Dawnbook infringes upon your copyright, you may submit a formal notification in writing containing the following requirements:
dmca.notice.item1.text: A physical or electronic signature of a person authorized to act on behalf of the owner of an exclusive right that is allegedly infringed.
dmca.notice.item2.text: Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to have been infringed, or a representative list of such works.
dmca.notice.item3.text: Identification of the material that is claimed to be infringing, including specific URLs on Dawnbook.
dmca.notice.item4.text: Your full legal name, physical mailing address, telephone number, and active email address.
dmca.notice.item5.text: A statement that you have a good faith belief that use of the material in the manner complained of is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
dmca.notice.item6.text: A statement that the information in the notification is accurate, and under penalty of perjury, that you are authorized to act on behalf of the owner.
dmca.agent.title: 3. Designated Copyright Agent
dmca.agent.body: Please deliver all DMCA notifications to our designated copyright agent:
dmca.counter.title: 4. Counter-Notification Procedure
dmca.counter.body: If your content was removed or disabled as a result of a DMCA notice and you believe this was due to mistake or misidentification, you may send a written counter-notification pursuant to 17 U.S.C. § 512(g)(3) containing your contact details, identification of the removed material, consent to jurisdiction, and statement under penalty of perjury.
dmca.repeat.title: 5. Repeat Infringer Policy
dmca.repeat.body: In accordance with the DMCA and other applicable laws, Dawnbook maintains a policy of terminating, in appropriate circumstances, contributor privileges or account access for users who are deemed to be repeat infringers.
